samples.xml_description:
<module id="edge_detect">
    <description>Detects rising and falling edges of a slow-changing 1-bit signal 'a' and outputs corresponding signals 'rise' and 'down'.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="a">Slow-changing 1-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="rise">Rising edge detected, output 1.</output>
        <output id="down">Falling edge detected, output 1.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="RISE">1'b1</parameter>
        <parameter id="DOWN">1'b1</parameter>
        <parameter id="ZERO">1'b0</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="prev_a" type="reg" width_description="[0:0]" init_value="ZERO">Previous value of signal 'a'</signal>
        <signal id="rise_reg" type="reg" width_description="[0:0]" init_value="ZERO">Register to hold the rising edge status</signal>
        <signal id="down_reg" type="reg" width_description="[0:0]" init_value="ZERO">Register to hold the falling edge status</signal>
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)> <!-- Always block triggered on the positive edge of the clock or negative edge of reset -->
            if (~rst_n) begin // If reset signal is active
                prev_a <= ZERO; // Initialize previous value of 'a' to zero
                rise_reg <= ZERO; // Initialize rising edge register to zero
                down_reg <= ZERO; // Initialize falling edge register to zero
            end else begin // If reset signal is not active
                prev_a <= a; // Update previous value of 'a' with current value of 'a'
                
                // Check for rising edge
                if ((prev_a == ZERO && a == RISE)) begin
                    rise_reg <= RISE; // Set rising edge register to one
                end else begin
                    rise_reg <= ZERO; // Reset rising edge register
                end
                
                // Check for falling edge
                if ((prev_a == RISE && a == ZERO)) begin
                    down_reg <= DOWN; // Set falling edge register to one
                end else begin
                    down_reg <= ZERO; // Reset falling edge register
                end
            end
        </endalways>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Edge detection logic based on sequential logic.</implementation>
    
    <task id="reset_task">
        <description>Resets the module's state variables.</description>
        <block>
            <assign id="prev_a" value="ZERO"/>
            <assign id="rise_reg" value="ZERO"/>
            <assign id="down_reg" value="ZERO"/>
        </block>
    </task>
    
    <task id="detect_edges_task">
        <description>Detects rising and falling edges.</description>
        <block>
            <if condition="(prev_a == ZERO && a == RISE)">
                <assign id="rise_reg" value="RISE"/>
            </if>
            <else>
                <assign id="rise_reg" value="ZERO"/>
            </else>
            
            <if condition="(prev_a == RISE && a == ZERO)">
                <assign id="down_reg" value="DOWN"/>
            </if>
            <else>
                <assign id="down_reg" value="ZERO"/>
            </else>
        </block>
    </task>
</module>
